target: Specialized bound K_2(C_K) for L_7 at the coefficient prime 2
conclusion: The reviewed large-prime K-theory bounds do not establish this dyadic bound without an additional argument.

sources.title: Christophe Soulé, A Bound for the Torsion in the K-Theory of Algebraic Integers (2003)
sources.scope: The torsion bound omits small primes; the étale-cohomology product in Theorem 3 is over sufficiently large odd primes. It does not cover the coefficient prime 2.

sources.title: Alejandro de la Torre Durán, Perfect Forms and Torsion Bounds in Algebraic K-Theory over Totally Real and CM Fields
sources.scope: The improved bound still omits a specified set of small primes. Remark 4.4 corrects the cyclotomic-intersection assumption in the older prime cutoff. This improvement does not itself supply the missing dyadic estimate.

own_consequences: A bound on the number of generators or on mod-2 dimension does not bound length: Z/2^n has one generator for every n.
The manuscript proves the matrix, fixed-center, exceptional-set, local-cohomology and fractional-ideal comparisons; its dyadic common-window deduction remains conditional on K_2.

The remaining global strict-group size estimate must be proved through the archive's class-counting chain or a separately justified replacement; none of the checked literature bounds closes it as stated.
